attackers_goals: This activity was an important stage for several exploits.
description: Lsass.exe does not normally create executables to disk. This activity was seen as part of several exploits, like EternalBlue and DoublePulsar, used during the WannaCry attacks.
investigative_actions: Check the file that was written to the disk for malicious activities.
name: Executable created to disk by lsass.exe
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
